name: Farmers Branch
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Farmers Branch, TX 2026
seo_description: Kids' Christmas in Farmers Branch, TX: Christmas Carnival and tree lighting, Santa on the Move, Pancakes and Pajamas and Manske Library Santa and Cookies.
lede: The story of Christmas in Farmers Branch starts with a creek town called Mustang Branch in 1843 and still centers on the 1856 Gilbert House, where the Historical Park has held Christmas Teas as a tradition. Today the city's Christmas in the Branch program fills December, led by A Christmas Carnival and tree lighting at City Hall, which the city says draws more than 6,000 people a year.
sections: From Mustang Branch to Farmers Branch

Farmers Branch began with a handful of land grants. Keenan, Webb and Cochran, three settlers, all arrived in 1842, and by 1843 the settlers had a community called Mustang Branch, named for the mustang grapes along the creek. Cochran later changed the name to Farmers Branch because of the area's rich farmland. On May 5, 1845, Isaac Webb founded Webb's Chapel, the first formal church in Dallas County, and he became the first postmaster on January 5, 1848. The town stayed small for a century and was incorporated in April 1946, according to the Texas State Historical Association's Handbook of Texas.
The Gilbert House and Christmas at the Historical Park

The cornerstone of the Farmers Branch Historical Park is the Gilbert House, built in 1856 by Dr. Samuel H. Gilbert. The City of Farmers Branch says it is the oldest structure still on its original foundation in Dallas County, with two foot thick limestone walls, chestnut plank floors and an open middle hallway that makes it a dogtrot house. It was named a Recorded Texas Historic Landmark in 1988. The park's Christmas Teas are described by the city as a Historical Park tradition, with live harp music, treats and Christmas decor in Venue 1842, and a guided tour of the park's Christmas Exhibit.
Christmas in the Branch and the trains nearby

The city's Christmas in the Branch calendar packs the month with Santa. A Christmas Carnival and tree lighting at City Hall, Santa on the move in a fire truck, pancakes in pajamas at the Recreation Center and cookies with Santa at Manske Library all sit on the city's list. Trains shaped the town too: the Dallas and Wichita Railway, which arrived in 1878, passed through Farmers Branch before it became part of the Missouri, Kansas and Texas in 1881. Today DART's Green Line stops at Farmers Branch Station on Denton Drive, so families can ride light rail to the neighborhood.
celebrates: Farmers Branch celebrates through the City of Farmers Branch's Christmas in the Branch calendar. The month opens with Letters to Santa and Feliz Navidog, then A Christmas Carnival at City Hall brings rides, a snow slide, crafts, a holiday marketplace and a tree lighting. Santa also rides through neighborhoods on a fire truck, and the Manske Library hosts cookies with Santa and a holiday pajama storytime. At the Historical Park, the Christmas Teas continue a long park tradition, and the city's Gilbert House, built in 1856, anchors that park.
lastyear: The city does not publish a recap of last year's events on the pages we read, so this page sticks to what the host says. The city lists Christmas in the Branch as a month of festive programs and says the Christmas events draw more than 6,000 attendees each year, according to the city's Christmas in the Branch page, which also lists Gateway to the Globe, Independence Day and Halloween in the Park as other annual city events.
facts: Farmers Branch was first called Mustang Branch, after the mustang grapes along the creek. Isaac Webb founded Webb's Chapel there on May 5, 1845, the first formal church in Dallas County. The Gilbert House, built in 1856, is the oldest structure still on its original foundation in Dallas County and was named a Recorded Texas Historic Landmark in 1988. The city was incorporated in April 1946.
trains: DART's Green Line stops at Farmers Branch Station, 12800 Denton Drive, and DART also connects riders to the Denton County Transportation Authority's A-train at Trinity Mills Station in Carrollton, which links Denton with the Green Line. The Trinity Railway Express and Amtrak's Texas Eagle both stop at EBJ Union Station in downtown Dallas. For a bigger train day, ride the McKinney Avenue M-Line Trolley in Dallas, or visit the Interurban Railway Museum in Plano and the Museum of the American Railroad in Frisco.

faq: Where is the Farmers Branch Christmas tree lighting?

The City of Farmers Branch lights its Christmas tree at City Hall, 13000 William Dodson Parkway, as part of A Christmas Carnival. The city lists carnival games, a trackless train, rides, a snow slide, free pictures with Santa and Elf on the Shelf, a holiday marketplace, food trucks and a drone show with the tree lighting.
Does Santa visit Farmers Branch neighborhoods?

Yes. The city's Santa and Friends on the Move loads Santa and friends into a fire truck and city vehicles to visit neighborhoods, and the route ends at the Joya Playground at Oran Good Park, 13201 Tom Field Road, where families can join Santa for cookies while supplies last.
Where can kids see Santa at the library in Farmers Branch?

The Manske Library, 13613 Webb Chapel Road, hosts Santa and Cookies, with cookies, a holiday craft and a visit with Santa, and Sweet Holiday Storytime, where children are invited to wear holiday pajamas. The City of Farmers Branch lists both as free.
What is Christmas in the Branch?

It is the City of Farmers Branch's month of festive programs, including A Christmas Carnival, Letters to Santa, Feliz Navidog, Santa Makes House Calls, Santa and Cookies, Pancakes and Pajamas and Christmas Teas. The city says its Christmas events draw more than 6,000 attendees each year.
Can you take the train to Farmers Branch?
DART's Green Line serves Farmers Branch Station at 12800 Denton Drive. DART connects with the DCTA A-train at Trinity Mills Station in Carrollton, which links Denton with the Green Line.
What is the oldest building in Farmers Branch?
The Gilbert House, built in 1856 in the Farmers Branch Historical Park. The city says it is the oldest structure still on its original foundation in Dallas County.
